chunks.subject: AP US History
chunks.title: SAQ exemplar — Q3 (No Stimulus) Sample 3A, 3/3
chunks.content: SAQ Q3 (no stimulus: political developments in British North America, 1607–1753) scored 3/3 (A 1, B 1, C 1). A describes one political development in the period; B and C explain further developments/effects as directed. Full credit — each part completes its describe/explain task with accurate, in-period evidence.

chunks.subject: AP US History
chunks.title: SAQ exemplar — Q3 Sample 3B, 2/3
chunks.content: SAQ Q3 scored 2/3 (A 0, B 1, C 1). Parts B and C earn credit, but Part A does not — the described development is inaccurate, outside 1607–1753, or merely a named term without the required characteristics. Because parts are independent, missing the describe part does not block the explain parts.

chunks.subject: AP US History
chunks.title: SAQ exemplar — Q3 Sample 3C, 1/3
chunks.content: SAQ Q3 scored 1/3 (A 0, B 0, C 1). Only Part C earns credit; A and B fail (inaccurate, off-period, or not completing the describe/explain task). Demonstrates that any single part can be the one earned — points are independent.
